# hostereo_tag (Resource)

A tag for instances. The API cannot delete tags: `terraform destroy` only removes it from state (with a warning).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hostereo_tag" "prod" {
  name = "prod"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `instances_count` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import hostereo_tag.prod 9b2e7c1d-4a5f-4d3e-8c7b-1f2a3b4c5d6e
```
